metadata.title: FORCE DE LA POUDRE ET DES MATIÈRES EXPLOSIVES

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main titles exhibit the high contrast between thick and thin strokes and the vertical stress characteristic of the Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was the standard for formal French academic and official printing in the late 19th century.
